project_type: Monorepo: FastAPI (Python) backend, Vite+React (JSX) frontend, Cloudflare Worker (TypeScript) edge
build_system: pnpm workspaces for frontend/edge, pip-compile for backend, Docker for backend deployment
test_framework: pytest for backend, vitest for frontend and edge, playwright for e2e
build_command: pnpm build:frontend && pnpm build:edge && docker build -t syrabit-backend apps/backend
test_command: cd apps/frontend && npx vitest run; cd apps/edge && npx vitest run; cd apps/backend && pytest tests/
verification_instructions: Run frontend build, edge typecheck, and backend Docker build. Run available unit tests.
setup_instructions: pnpm install (root); cd apps/frontend && pnpm install; cd apps/edge && npm install; cd apps/backend && pip install -r requirements.txt
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Node 22, Python 3.11 available. Docker daemon available.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing code patterns.
key_patterns: Beanie ODM for MongoDB, httpx async clients for AI services, circuit breakers for resilience, KV-based rate limiting at edge, Redis monthly quota at backend, HMAC-signed edge-to-backend trust, JWT (HS256/RS256) auth
directory_structure: apps/backend/ - FastAPI Python backend with Beanie ODM, services for AI/search/payments; apps/frontend/ - Vite+React SPA with SSR support, TailwindCSS, lazy-loaded pages; apps/edge/ - Cloudflare Worker acting as edge shield (JWT, rate limit, proxy, CORS); infra/ - GCP/deployment scripts; docker-compose.yml - local dev stack
